patterns.note: The initial viewport is characterized by extreme sparseness and vast negative space, with minimal text elements positioned at the top, creating a sense of anticipation before revealing more structured content further down the page.

A single sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with strong hierarchical contrast achieved through varying weights and sizes; large, bold uppercase headings are paired with smaller, lighter body text and very small uppercase labels.
The design strictly adheres to a monochromatic black and white palette, creating a stark, high-contrast, and sophisticated visual identity.

Content sections and individual text elements are designed to reveal or animate into view with smooth transitions as the user scrolls down the page, suggesting a dynamic, unfolding experience rather than a static layout.
Client lists are presented in a clean, two-column text-link format, maintaining the minimalist aesthetic while providing clear navigation to portfolio examples.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to provide an enhanced, fluid scroll experience, likely integrated with scroll-triggered animations that reveal content sections and text elements as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging page load effect.

Typography relies on a single sans-serif font family, leveraging variations in weight and size to establish a clear visual hierarchy, with uppercase styling used for emphasis on labels and key headings.
The design utilizes a high-contrast black and white color scheme, with generous negative space around elements to ensure readability and a premium, uncluttered aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and very small uppercase labels, creating a strong hierarchical contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — extremely airy initial viewport, balanced spacing in client lists and footer sections.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the extreme minimalism and the deliberate use of vast negative space, particularly in the initial viewport, which creates a sense of anticipation and focuses attention solely on the sparse text elements. This, combined with the implied smooth scroll and reveal animations, makes the page feel like an unfolding experience rather than a static layout.
